```plato

// An inverse-kinematics chain: a run of bones solved so the last reaches the
// target. BoneIndices runs root-to-tip along a parent chain; PoleTarget pulls
// the chain's bend plane (elbow or knee direction); Iterations bounds the
// solver loop and Tolerance is the end-effector distance below which it stops
// early. (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Inverse_kinematics)
type IkChain
    implements IValue
{
    BoneIndices: Array<BoneIndex>;
    Target: IkTarget;
    PoleTarget: Point3D;
    Solver: IkSolver;
    Iterations: Integer;
    Tolerance: Number;
}

// Aims one bone at a world-space target. Aim is the bone-local axis to point at
// the target; Up is the bone-local axis kept aligned to the world up to control
// roll. Weight blends the constrained result over the input pose.
type LookAtConstraint
    implements IValue
{
    Bone: BoneIndex;
    Target: Point3D;
    Aim: Vector3D;
    Up: Vector3D;
    Weight: Proportion;
}

// Propagates a fraction of a source bone's twist about an axis onto another
// bone; used for forearm and neck twist distribution. Axis is expressed in the
// source bone's local space.
type TwistConstraint
    implements IValue
{
    Bone: BoneIndex;
    SourceBone: BoneIndex;
    Axis: Vector3D;
    Fraction: Proportion;
}

// Per-bone blend weights, parallel to the owning skeleton's bone array. Scales
// an animation layer's influence bone by bone (upper-body-only layers, fade-out
// at chain roots).
type BoneMask
    implements IValue
{
    Weights: Array<Proportion>;
}

// Maps the bones of a source skeleton onto a target skeleton for animation
// retargeting. TargetBoneIndices is parallel to the source skeleton's bones;
// each entry is the corresponding target bone's index, or -1 when unmapped.
type RetargetMap
    implements IValue
{
    TargetBoneIndices: Array<BoneIndex>;
}
```
